items.example: We all need to pay attention to the rules of photography.

items.phrase: be mindful of where you are
items.example: Always be mindful of where you are before snapping.
Be mindful before you start snapping away.
The rules should be clear, but check if in doubt.
Ask if you're unsure about taking selfies there.
Ask yourself: should I be taking this photo?
Checking with a local should stop you upsetting anyone.
It's best to ask permission before the shot.
People may not act naturally if you ask first.
Take the photo, then show it to the person.
You can ask permission after the fact.
Taking photos of strangers' children is frowned upon.
He wants to raise awareness of a social issue.
Take a photo that truly represents the situation.
Never cause harm to wildlife when photographing nature.
